why: The sweep's question is 'is there a transcription model meaningfully better than what we have'. What this platform HAS is Basic Pitch — per docs/model-discovery/README.md it is the only external transcription model ever proven live on this infrastructure (PR-37, PR-46). MT3 is catalogued and has never run here, so it is the plan's baseline, not the incumbent. Both are worth a number; this image measures the one that is actually in production.

basic_pitch.pinSource: services/music-ai-worker/model_manifest.json — the same version the production analysis worker reviews, so the incumbent measured here is the incumbent that runs
basic_pitch.architecture: small CNN over harmonic-stacked CQT; frame, onset and contour heads
basic_pitch.capability: polyphonic pitch only — one instrument-agnostic note stream
basic_pitch.capabilityNote: Basic Pitch predicts no instrument and no drum flag. It is not a multi-instrument transcriber and was never claimed to be. Scoring it on instrument-aware F1 is therefore scoring it on a task it does not perform; the sweep reports that number for completeness and reports the pitch-only number next to it as the fair comparison. Its notes are assigned GM program 0 because the platform has to put them somewhere, and that choice — not a model prediction — is what the instrument-aware number is measuring.

runtime.gpu: none — a small CNN on CPU; a GPU would buy nothing and cost budget
